question: At exactly lambda=0, can the scale-invariant differentiated logarithmic derivative h(4;kappa)=partial_lambda[-u_Q/u] be enclosed on all five previously certified characteristic-root brackets by an exact Bessel Green identity, rigorous finite acb quadrature, and an analytic improper-tail bound?

upstream_results.role: pins the exact lambda-zero recessive Bessel direction and the five full high-precision kappa brackets

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, modified-Bessel order symmetry and integral representation, sections 10.27 and 10.32, especially 10.32.9
primary_sources.used_for: K_(i*kappa) reality together with order symmetry, and K_(i*kappa)(x)=integral exp(-x cosh t) cos(kappa t)dt for the uniform improper-tail majorant
primary_sources.not_used_for: the emitted ball quadrature, nonzero-lambda transport, endpoint F_lambda, spectral data or RAQ

primary_sources.source: Fredrik Johansson, Arb: Efficient Arbitrary-Precision Midpoint-Radius Interval Arithmetic
primary_sources.not_used_for: the Green identity, improper-tail theorem or a raw-C operator conclusion

primary_sources.source: python-flint acb complex-ball integration and special-function interface
primary_sources.used_for: locked access to rigorous finite acb.integral enclosures and scaled complex-order Bessel K balls, with the analytic flag forwarded to square root
primary_sources.not_used_for: improper integration without a manual tail bound, or treating same-backend precision repeats as independent validation

declared_conventions.kappa_source: the five full 120-digit sign-change brackets certified by the pinned upstream result
declared_conventions.correct_plus_end_condition: u(Q)^2*h(Q) tends to zero; h itself grows asymptotically and is not set to zero
declared_conventions.improper_tail_majorant: J_tail<=pi*exp(-2Y)/(4*sqrt(x_plus+Y)); divide by sqrt(C)*S_kappa(x_plus)^2 for the h-tail
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy identities plus python-flint/Arb Bessel balls and rigorous acb.integral on a finite positive-real segment; no ODE solve, root solve, finite difference or unbounded numerical quadrature

assumptions: The calculation is exactly at lambda=0 and only on the five full upstream kappa brackets; it is neither a point sample nor a cover of all kappa in [0,8].
The exact Green identity is used directly. The earlier Liouville-Green error inequality is not differentiated and supplies no h error term here.
For real kappa and positive x, K_(i*kappa)(x) is real by conjugation and K order symmetry. The finite quadrature still retains the full complex ball and requires its imaginary part to contain zero.
The DLMF 10.32.9 representation and cosh(t)>=1+t^2/2 give |K_(i*kappa)(x)|<=K_0(x)<=exp(-x)*sqrt(pi/(2x)); this bounds only the manually separated improper tail.
Every denominator is evaluated on an entire exact-rational kappa bracket and must have a strictly positive real lower bound. A bracket for which zero is not excluded fails closed.
Both precision tiers use the same locked python-flint/FLINT-Arb backend. Their overlap and refinement are consistency checks, not independent validation.
A numerical amplitude F_lambda remains normalization-dependent away from an endpoint root. This calculation emits only the normalization-invariant h(4) datum and no endpoint transport.
tasks: verify the upstream result hash, payload hash, verdict and VALID_RUN state, then load all five full certified high-precision kappa brackets
verify exactly the Riccati sensitivity equation, Green/Wronskian identity, Q-to-x measure factor, scaled-Bessel cancellation and amplitude-rescaling invariance
cover every exact-rational kappa bracket by one outward-rounded Arb interval and require the scaled K denominator to be real and strictly positive on the whole band
for each band at 80 and 120 decimal digits, use acb.integral on y in [0,32], forward the analytic flag to sqrt, cap every callback, and retain the full complex enclosure
derive the improper-tail bound independently from DLMF 10.32.9 and add its outward-rounded interval after dividing by the certified denominator lower bound
require each h enclosure to be positive and narrower than its declared tier target, require the two rigorous tier enclosures to overlap, and use their intersection as the final band certificate
write node-safe transport, endpoint F_lambda, spectral, RAQ, BFV, physical and TOE outputs as explicit nulls

decision_table.condition: all source pins, exact identities, full-band denominator checks, finite quadratures, analytic tail bounds, tier width checks and refinement intersections pass for all five brackets
any source pin, exact identity, full-band denominator, finite quadrature, analytic-tail, width or refinement-overlap check fails
